day0_entry.title: Day 0: our own record, as five engines state it
day0_entry.body_markdown:
This is Broadcastwell's own record. We measure other companies' AI records for a living, so we start with ours, in public, under the same rules we sell.

In our [State of GEO study](https://broadcastwell.com/state-of-geo), 30 of 85 B2B software companies were never named in the answers for their own category. We show our own result here and fix it in public for 30 days, with a receipt for every step.

Day 0 was measured on 14 October 2026 under the [published method, v1.1](https://broadcastwell.com/methodology): ten buyer questions for the category "AI search visibility agencies for B2B software companies", asked on ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews and Google AI Mode, three scheduled runs, 150 planned answers.

- Named: 0 of 105 valid answers name Broadcastwell (0%, 95% interval 0% to 3.5%).
- Cited as a source: 0 of 105 valid answers cite a page on broadcastwell.com (0%, 95% interval 0% to 3.5%).
- Record accuracy: 0 statements classed wrong or stale. No answer names us, so there is no statement about us to class yet.

45 of the 150 planned answers are excluded from both sides of every count. Each is a Google answer that introduced a list of agencies that did not reach us whole: in 41, Google did not return the list itself; in 2, the answer named none of the agencies it introduced; in 2, advice came where the agencies should have been. We never count an answer we could not read in full as "not named". ChatGPT, Claude and Perplexity returned all 90 of their answers in full; no answer was cut short and no engine returned an error. The 105 valid answers are the base for every rate.

The engines name other agencies instead, Omniscient Digital, WebFX and First Page Sage most often, and cite their pages and third party guides. Every number above links to its receipts.

The plan lists the questions we lose, the sources the engines cite where we are absent, and the changes we will make on our own site and beyond it. Each weekday we publish what we changed. On day 30 we measure again on the same ten questions, the same engines and the same three runs, and publish the before and after, whatever it shows.

No result is promised. We promise the work and the day 30 measurement.

log.title: Day 1: five answer pages live on broadcastwell.com
log.body_markdown:
Day 1 of 30. Yesterday evening, after the day 0 record went live, our site team published five answer pages on broadcastwell.com, one for each of five buyer questions on our frozen panel. Each page answers its question from our company facts, pricing and methodology pages, and from nothing else. We fetched every page again today, signed out, and each one is served:

- Agencies for B2B software companies: https://broadcastwell.com/ai-search-visibility-agencies-b2b-software
- Agencies for a mid sized company: https://broadcastwell.com/ai-search-visibility-agencies-mid-sized-companies
- For a head of operations: https://broadcastwell.com/ai-search-visibility-for-operations-leaders
- What to look for when choosing an agency: https://broadcastwell.com/how-to-choose-an-ai-search-visibility-agency
- How to compare agencies before signing: https://broadcastwell.com/compare-ai-search-visibility-agencies-before-signing

In progress: requests to the authors of five agency lists the engines cited are drafted and held for a final review before they go out; each one appears here once it is sent. One approved client result is drafted for our company facts page and the five answer pages and is not yet published. Nothing in this entry changes a day 0 number. The first observation run, one run and not the measurement, is due Friday. The day 30 measurement uses the same ten questions on ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews and Google AI Mode.
